records.jp: ごく平凡な少女。補習を受けるために夏休み中の学校へ行ったはずが、気が付くと見知らぬ世界へと迷い込んでいた。現実とは思えない事態に戸惑いを覚えつつも、憧れていたファンタジーのような境遇を楽しんでいる。
records.en_original: A totally ordinary girl. She was supposed to spend her summer vacation going to class, but instead finds herself in a strange and mysterious world. This unthinkable turn of events has rendered her lost and confused, but that won't stop her from enjoying her new home in this fantastical world!
records.en: A totally ordinary girl. She was supposed to spend her summer vacation going to class, but instead finds herself in a strange and mysterious world. This unthinkable turn of events has rendered her lost and confused, but that won't stop her from enjoying her new home in this fantastical world!

records.jp: ^00雫世界の中で少女たちのリーダーとして活躍すること。それが自分の憧れていた“特別”へと至る道だと考えた愛央は少女たちのまとめ役として奮闘していた。しかし、二度目のクラックの際に自分は何も変わることができていないのだと思い知る。そんな中、この世界で出会った少女たちとのつながりがいつの間にか“特別”なものになっていたと気付いた彼女は、そのつながりを守るために、改めてリーダーとして立ち上がる。
records.en_original: ^00Ao has been chosen as the leader of the girls in Oasis. Seeing it as an opportunity to achieve the specialness she has always longed for, she puts her all into the role. However, seeing the second Crack makes her waver, wondering whether she's actually been able to change a single thing... But realizing that the bonds she's formed with the other girls in this world are what is truly special, she rises once again as their leader to protect those bonds.
records.en: ^00Ao has been chosen as the leader of the girls in Oasis. Seeing it as an opportunity to achieve the specialness she has always longed for, she puts her all into the role. However, seeing the second Crack makes her waver, wondering whether she's actually been able to change a single thing... But realizing that the bonds she's formed with the other girls in this world are what is truly special, she rises once again as their leader to protect those bonds.

records.jp: ^00特別な何かを持つ何者かになりたかった愛央は、さまざまな特別と出会い、さまざまな特別を手にしてきた。その中で彼女は気が付く。自分が本当に求めるものは、“特別”のさらに先にあるのだと。だから彼女は、みんなを助け幸せにするために、この作戦を実行することにした。
records.en_original: ^00Ao has spent a long time striving to become somebody special. But after encountering all manner of extraordinary things, she now understands that her true desire is something far beyond being special. She decides to put a new plan into motion: to help everyone become happy.
records.en: ^00Ao has spent a long time striving to become somebody special. But after encountering all manner of extraordinary things, she now understands that her true desire is something far beyond being special. She decides to put a new plan into motion: to help everyone become happy.

records.jp: 愛央たちが作ったカフェスペースの中から現れた少女。記憶を失っており、昔会ったことのある詩帆のことは覚えていない。落ち着いた性格で、どこか達観したような雰囲気を纏っている。バレリーナだった過去は忘れてしまったが、バレエと聞くと心のどこかがざわつくような感覚になる。
records.en_original: A girl that appeared in the newly created cafe space. Having lost all her memories, she doesn't remember meeting Shiho. She's generally quite naturally calm and collected, and has a bit of a philosophical side. Even though she has no recollection of ever being a ballerina, her heart still races at the mention of ballet.
records.en: A girl that appeared in the newly created cafe space. Having lost all her memories, she doesn't remember meeting Shiho. She's generally quite naturally calm and collected, and has a bit of a philosophical side. Even though she has no recollection of ever being a ballerina, her heart still races at the mention of ballet.

records.jp: ^00かつて彼女は将来を嘱望された天才バレリーナだった。しかし練習中の怪我が原因で、膝に重い後遺症を負ってしまう。生きがいだったバレエを踊れなくなり、失意のどん底にいた彼女を救い出したのは、夕月と来夢だった。全てを思い出した日菜子は、二人と再会することを決意する。
records.en_original: ^00Once lauded as a ballet prodigy, she lost everything when a terrible knee injury rendered her unable to dance. Ballet was her life, and without it, she didn't know if it was worth living. Yuzuki and Lime were the ones who rescued her from this pit of despair. Now that her memories have returned, Hinako is determined to see them again.
records.en: ^00Once lauded as a ballet prodigy, she lost everything when a terrible knee injury rendered her unable to dance. Ballet was her life, and without it, she didn't know if it was worth living. Yuzuki and Lime were the ones who rescued her from this pit of despair. Now that her memories have returned, Hinako is determined to see them again.

records.jp: ^00日菜子はかつての親友である夕月と来夢との再会を果たし、抱えていた想いを吐露する。二人がいなくなって寂しかったこと、世界をおかしくしてしまったのは自分なのではないかという罪悪感。夕月と来夢の温かい言葉に、日菜子は救われていった。しかし彼女は、この時間が奇跡であることを知っている。再び離れ離れになるまでのわずかな時間を、彼女たちは噛みしめるように生きる。
records.en_original: ^00Hinako finally gets to express all her pent-up emotions when she is reunited with her long-lost friends, Yuzuki and Lime. Not only had she been lonely without them, she had also been wracking herself with guilt wondering if she was the one responsible for what had happened to the world. But her worries have been melted away by the sisters' kind words. Yet she knows that their reunion is but a short-lived miracle, and that they must press on until the time for bitter goodbyes is upon them again.
records.en: ^00Hinako finally gets to express all her pent-up emotions when she is reunited with her long-lost friends, Yuzuki and Lime. Not only had she been lonely without them, she had also been wracking herself with guilt wondering if she was the one responsible for what had happened to the world. But her worries have been melted away by the sisters' kind words. Yet she knows that their reunion is but a short-lived miracle, and that they must press on until the time for bitter goodbyes is upon them again.

records.jp: ^00足の故障をきっかけに普通に生きることを始めた元天才の日菜子。愛央ともっと仲良くなるために、普通になろうと努力するが、取り戻した記憶から互いに自然体でいられるのが本当の友達なのだと知る。^00 ^00そうして日菜子と愛央は、無理せず自然体でいられる友達として特別な関係を築いた。
records.en_original: ^00Hinako, a former ballet prodigy, had to start living an ordinary life after injuring her leg. She tries her best to act normal to get closer to Ao, but her old memories show her that true friendship is being able to act natural around one another, not pretending to be something you're not.^00 ^00Hinako and Ao have formed a special bond where they can fully be themselves around each other.
records.en: ^00Hinako, a former ballet prodigy, had to start living an ordinary life after injuring her leg. She tries her best to act normal to get closer to Ao, but her old memories show her that true friendship is being able to act natural around one another, not pretending to be something you're not.^00 ^00Hinako and Ao have formed a special bond where they can fully be themselves around each other.

records.jp: 愛央がこの世界にやってきて初めて出会った少女。水に囲まれた学校で、伶那と勇希と３人で生活していた。この世界で目覚める前の記憶を失っているらしい。おっとりとした性格だが、意外としっかり者。理由はわからないが、「秘密基地」という言葉に引っかかりを覚えている。
records.en_original: The first girl that Ao encountered in this strange world. She's been living in the school with Rena and Yuki, and seems to be unable to recall anything prior to waking up here. She's mild-mannered and kind, but also surprisingly bold. She can't recall exactly why, but she remembers being drawn to the idea of a secret hideout.
records.en: The first girl that Ao encountered in this strange world. She's been living in the school with Rena and Yuki, and seems to be unable to recall anything prior to waking up here. She's mild-mannered and kind, but also surprisingly bold. She can't recall exactly why, but she remembers being drawn to the idea of a secret hideout.

records.jp: ^00幼少期は内気な性格で、いじめを受けることも多かった。そんな彼女にとって、幼馴染の春日詩帆の存在は強い心の支えだった。秘密基地が好きだったのは、そんな詩帆と二人で作った思い出があったから。詩帆とはその後離れ離れになってしまったが、その出会いがこころを大きく変え、やがて人類を守るリフレクターを目指すきっかけとなった。猟師である父親の影響で猟銃の心得があるこころは、リフレクターに変身した際もライフルを使用する。
records.en_original: ^00Kokoro was a shy and introverted child, which unfortunately made her a target for bullies. Her childhood friend, Shiho Kasuga, was the one that carried her through those tough years. The reason she is drawn to a secret hideout is because of her precious memories of building one with Shiho. The universe would go on to separate the two of them, but their friendship changed Kokoro forever, spurring her to become a Reflector. Her father was a skilled hunter, which is why she uses a rifle in her Reflector form.
records.en: ^00Kokoro was a shy and introverted child, which unfortunately made her a target for bullies. Her childhood friend, Shiho Kasuga, was the one that carried her through those tough years. The reason she is drawn to a secret hideout is because of her precious memories of building one with Shiho. The universe would go on to separate the two of them, but their friendship changed Kokoro forever, spurring her to become a Reflector. Her father was a skilled hunter, which is why she uses a rifle in her Reflector form.

records.jp: ^00どんな相手でも、歩み寄って、仲良くできるのが一番。こころはいじめっ子たちと和解した記憶を思い出し、今の自分を形作る大切な想いを取り戻した。その想いがあるからこそ、雫世界に来たばかりの愛央の手を引くことができて、今の二人がある。^00 ^00そうしてこころと愛央は、つらいことがあっても互いに手を引いて歩いていける一番の親友として特別な関係を築いた。
records.en_original: ^00Kokoro believes that no matter who you're dealing with, you've got to get along and meet them halfway. Regaining her memory of compromising with her bullies helped her remember who she truly is. It was the very same Kokoro who reached out to Ao when she first arrived in Oasis.^00 ^00Kokoro and Ao have become very special friends. No matter how hard things get, they can always depend on each other.
records.en: ^00Kokoro believes that no matter who you're dealing with, you've got to get along and meet them halfway. Regaining her memory of compromising with her bullies helped her remember who she truly is. It was the very same Kokoro who reached out to Ao when she first arrived in Oasis.^00 ^00Kokoro and Ao have become very special friends. No matter how hard things get, they can always depend on each other.

records.jp: 愛央がこの世界に来る前に暮らしていた少女のうちの一人。この世界で目覚める前の記憶を失っているらしい。物事をはっきりと言う性格で、はしゃぐことの多い愛央や勇希をよくたしなめている。
records.en_original: One of the girls who was already residing in this world before Ao arrived. She seems to be unable to recall anything prior to waking up here. As the kind of person who says whatever is on her mind, she often finds herself scolding the more cheerful and carefree Ao and Yuki.
records.en: One of the girls who was already residing in this world before Ao arrived. She seems to be unable to recall anything prior to waking up here. As the kind of person who says whatever is on her mind, she often finds herself scolding the more cheerful and carefree Ao and Yuki.

records.jp: ^00伶那は真面目で、そして不器用だった。何事にも物怖じせず、自分の思ったことを言える彼女は、その性格が災いして学校では孤立しがちだった。そんな時に出会った勇希は、伶那とはタイプの全く違う、素直で快活な少女だった。共に過ごすうち、伶那は自分にないものを持つ勇希に心惹かれていくが、灰病が二人の間を分かつ。それでも諦めなかった伶那は、勇希の行方を捜して灰の研究機関AASAへとたどり着く。伶那はそこで適性を見いだされ、リフレクターとなった。
records.en_original: ^00Rena was a serious but somewhat awkward girl. She was never afraid to speak her mind, which unfortunately led to a rather lonely school life. But then she met Yuki, a sweet and cheerful girl who couldn't have been more different than her. Rena was captivated by her, as Yuki had what she did not—but Ash Syndrome would soon tear them apart. However, this was not enough to make Rena falter. She searched far and wide for Yuki, ultimately stumbling upon an Ash research institute known as AASA. There, she learned that she had the aptitude to become a Reflector.
records.en: ^00Rena was a serious but somewhat awkward girl. She was never afraid to speak her mind, which unfortunately led to a rather lonely school life. But then she met Yuki, a sweet and cheerful girl who couldn't have been more different than her. Rena was captivated by her, as Yuki had what she did not—but Ash Syndrome would soon tear them apart. However, this was not enough to make Rena falter. She searched far and wide for Yuki, ultimately stumbling upon an Ash research institute known as AASA. There, she learned that she had the aptitude to become a Reflector.

records.jp: ^00勇希が記憶を取り戻したことで、伶那と勇希はようやくお互いの本当の気持ちを伝えることができた。勇希がすでに亡くなっていることも知ってしまった伶那だが、彼女は必ず勇希を助けると誓う。
records.en_original: ^00Yuki regains her memories, meaning that she and Rena can finally convey their true feelings to one another. Rena is now aware that Yuki is already dead, but she still holds on to her vow to save Yuki.
records.en: ^00Yuki regains her memories, meaning that she and Rena can finally convey their true feelings to one another. Rena is now aware that Yuki is already dead, but she still holds on to her vow to save Yuki.

records.jp: ^00ネガティブな伶那はあまり人を信じることができなかった。しかし、愛央やみんなと過ごしてきた時間が伶那のその心を変え、伶那は過去にもいろんな人が自分に手を差し伸べていたことに気が付く。世界の人々は、自分が思っているより強くて優しい。それを知った伶那なら、どんな困難にも立ち向かえるだろう。^00 ^00そうして伶那と愛央は、互いに信じ支えあえる一番の仲間として特別な関係を築いた。
records.en_original: ^00The often pessimistic Rena always struggled to put her trust in others, but she has a change of heart after spending time with Ao and the others. She realizes that throughout her life, people had, in fact, tried to reach out to her. The people of the world were much stronger and kinder than she had always believed. With this newfound understanding, she is now ready to face any trouble that comes her way.^00 ^00And so, Rena and Ao became close friends, establishing a tight bond based on mutual support and trust.
records.en: ^00The often pessimistic Rena always struggled to put her trust in others, but she has a change of heart after spending time with Ao and the others. She realizes that throughout her life, people had, in fact, tried to reach out to her. The people of the world were much stronger and kinder than she had always believed. With this newfound understanding, she is now ready to face any trouble that comes her way.^00 ^00And so, Rena and Ao became close friends, establishing a tight bond based on mutual support and trust.

records.jp: 活発で、誰とでも親しく接することができる少女。姉の美弦とともにこの世界にやってきた。何事もまずは行動するのが一番、という考え方で、様々なことに積極的に取り組む姿勢を見せる。こころとは元の世界で面識がある。
records.en_original: An earnest, active girl, able to make friends easily with anyone. Hiori and her sister, Mio, came to this world together. She's got a positive attitude, though she prefers to act first, think later. Kokoro and Hiori knew each other in the real world.
records.en: An earnest, active girl, able to make friends easily with anyone. Hiori and her sister, Mio, came to this world together. She's got a positive attitude, though she prefers to act first, think later. Kokoro and Hiori knew each other in the real world.

records.jp: ^00陽桜莉がまだ幼かったころ、団地で肩身の狭い思いをしていた彼女の母親は、ある日限界を迎え唐突に姿を消してしまった。残された姉妹はとあるきっかけでリフレクターとなり、互いに支え、時にすれ違いながらも、強く生きていく。そんなある日、姉妹の前に現れたのは同じリフレクターとして因縁を持つ駒川詩だった。何が目的か、詩によって導かれた姉妹は数年ぶりに母との再会を果たす。長きすれ違いの果てに、姉妹は再び家族の絆を取り戻した。あの日食べたカレーライスの味は、今も陽桜莉の胸の中に残っている。
records.en_original: ^00Unable to bear her situation any longer, Hiori's mother vanished without a trace, leaving the sisters to fend for themselves. This led them both to become Reflectors in order protect and support each other, as well as grow stronger together, despite their occasional differences. One day, they encountered Uta Komagawa, a Reflector just like them. Though her true motives were unclear, Uta reunited the sisters with their long-lost mother. At long last, the family was back together again. The taste of the curry they ate that day will forever remain in Hiori's heart.
records.en: ^00Unable to bear her situation any longer, Hiori's mother vanished without a trace, leaving the sisters to fend for themselves. This led them both to become Reflectors in order protect and support each other, as well as grow stronger together, despite their occasional differences. One day, they encountered Uta Komagawa, a Reflector just like them. Though her true motives were unclear, Uta reunited the sisters with their long-lost mother. At long last, the family was back together again. The taste of the curry they ate that day will forever remain in Hiori's heart.

records.jp: ^00過去の因縁から詩のことを良く思っていない陽桜莉だったが、人の善意を信じる彼女はそれでも詩に寄り添う態度を見せた。詩が今の詩でいられるのは、そういった陽桜莉の姿勢に詩が救われたからなのかもしれない。
records.en_original: ^00Initially distrustful of Uta due to their past, Hiori still tried to get closer to her, believing that good exists in every person. It's possible Hiori's faith in her is what allows Uta to be who she is today.
records.en: ^00Initially distrustful of Uta due to their past, Hiori still tried to get closer to her, believing that good exists in every person. It's possible Hiori's faith in her is what allows Uta to be who she is today.

records.jp: ^00物事の表面しか見ることができていないと悩んでいた陽桜莉だが、持ち前の底抜けな明るさがたくさんの人を救っていることを知り、信念を貫き自分らしくあることを誓う。^00 ^00そうして陽桜莉と愛央は、自分が自分らしくいられる友達として特別な関係を築いた。
records.en_original: ^00Worried that she may take things only at face value, Hiori learns that natural positivity is a comfort to many of those around her. She decides to be herself, and stick to what she believes in.^00 ^00In the end, Hiori and Ao formed a special friendship where they can just be themselves.
records.en: ^00Worried that she may take things only at face value, Hiori learns that natural positivity is a comfort to many of those around her. She decides to be herself, and stick to what she believes in.^00 ^00In the end, Hiori and Ao formed a special friendship where they can just be themselves.

records.jp: 愛央たちが作った海の家の中から現れた少女。記憶を失っており、幼馴染だったこころのことは覚えていない。礼儀正しく、いつも丁寧な口調で話す。理由は忘れてしまったが、コーヒーを好きだったことだけは覚えている。
records.en_original: A girl that appeared in the newly created beachside cafe. Having lost her memories, she has no recollection of Kokoro, her childhood friend. A very polite and well-mannered girl. She remembers liking coffee, although she doesn't recall the reason why.
records.en: A girl that appeared in the newly created beachside cafe. Having lost her memories, she has no recollection of Kokoro, her childhood friend. A very polite and well-mannered girl. She remembers liking coffee, although she doesn't recall the reason why.

records.jp: ^00詩帆の実家は喫茶店で、コーヒーが好きで料理が得意なのはその影響。小学生の頃に学校で問題を起こしたことが原因で、父親が仕事をやめなければならなくなり、その罪悪感から新たな家業をよく手伝っていた。そんな生活に不自由さを覚えながらも諦めて受け入れていたある日、喫茶店へ客として訪れた日菜子と出会う。彼女と話し、その前向きな考え方に感化された詩帆は、自分の抱える問題と向き合うようになった。
records.en_original: ^00Shiho once lived in the cafe that her parents ran, sparking her love of coffee and cooking. Her father was forced to quit his job after Shiho caused quite the stir at her elementary school. The guilt from this caused her to help wherever she could with the business. After resigning herself to a life without freedom, she met Hinako when the girl visited the cafe. Hinako inspired her to think positively and to face her problems head-on.
records.en: ^00Shiho once lived in the cafe that her parents ran, sparking her love of coffee and cooking. Her father was forced to quit his job after Shiho caused quite the stir at her elementary school. The guilt from this caused her to help wherever she could with the business. After resigning herself to a life without freedom, she met Hinako when the girl visited the cafe. Hinako inspired her to think positively and to face her problems head-on.

records.jp: ^00詩帆は自分のせいで両親に望まぬ道を強いたのではないかと気にしていたが、それに対し両親は喫茶店を開くのも一つの夢であったと答えていたことを思い出す。人生のレールはどれが正解かなんてわからない。平凡だと決めつけていたレールの先にだって、思いもよらない新たな出会い待ち受けているかもしれない。そう気が付いた詩帆は、自らの進むレールの先に素敵な景色があると信じ、ひたすら進み続けることを決意する。^00 ^00そうして詩帆と愛央は、同じレールの先を一緒に見届ける友達として特別な関係を築いた。
records.en_original: ^00Worried that she had forced her parents into a life they didn't ask for, Shiho learns that opening a cafe had always been a dream of theirs. It can hard to know what path is the right one to follow. Even a path that may seem mundane can lead to wonderful, unexpected encounters. Upon realizing this, Shiho decides it wouldn't hurt to continue down the path she has chosen. After all, who knows what wonderful sights may lie ahead?^00 ^00And so, Shiho and Ao became close friends. Together, they will discover what lies at the end of their path.
records.en: ^00Worried that she had forced her parents into a life they didn't ask for, Shiho learns that opening a cafe had always been a dream of theirs. It can hard to know what path is the right one to follow. Even a path that may seem mundane can lead to wonderful, unexpected encounters. Upon realizing this, Shiho decides it wouldn't hurt to continue down the path she has chosen. After all, who knows what wonderful sights may lie ahead?^00 ^00And so, Shiho and Ao became close friends. Together, they will discover what lies at the end of their path.

records.jp: 雫世界の創造主である来夢の姉。この場所が、何らかの理由で危機に瀕した世界から身を守るためのシェルターであることを明かす。彼女自身も記憶を失っているため、詳しいことは判明していない。本来の夕月は明るく活発な少女だったが、雫世界創造の代償として感情を失ってしまったようだ。素性が知れるまでは愛央たちからユーコちゃんと呼ばれていた。
records.en_original: The older sister of Lime, the creator of Oasis. She reveals to the girls that a terrible calamity occurred in the world, and Oasis was created to protect them. However, she is unable to remember the exact nature of the disaster. She used to be a bright and lively girl, but lost her emotions during the creation of Oasis. Ao and the others called her Yuko before they learned of her past.
records.en: The older sister of Lime, the creator of Oasis. She reveals to the girls that a terrible calamity occurred in the world, and Oasis was created to protect them. However, she is unable to remember the exact nature of the disaster. She used to be a bright and lively girl, but lost her emotions during the creation of Oasis. Ao and the others called her Yuko before they learned of her past.

records.jp: ^00来夢とともに、すべての人間のフラグメントが集まる場所、コモンの管理者をしていた少女。かつて世界が灰に包まれて崩壊した際、少しでも未来に希望をつなぐべく、リフレクターの少女たちの力を借りて“雫世界”を形成した。来夢が目覚めたことでサポートに回していた感情機能が開放され、かつてのような明朗快活・天真爛漫な司城夕月へと戻る。このような危機的状況であるものの、もう二度と会えないと思っていた大切な親友と言葉を交わせたのは、夕月にとって大きな救いとなった。
records.en_original: ^00Yuzu and her sister, Lime, were once the protectors of the Common, a place where all of humanity's fragments were stored. In order to protect the world from the Ash, they borrowed the powers of the other Reflectors to create the Oasis. Lime's awakening reignited Yuzu's emotions, returning her to her cheerful, energetic self. Though their situation is dire, she is happy to get a chance to talk to her best friend after thinking they may never meet again.
records.en: ^00Yuzu and her sister, Lime, were once the protectors of the Common, a place where all of humanity's fragments were stored. In order to protect the world from the Ash, they borrowed the powers of the other Reflectors to create the Oasis. Lime's awakening reignited Yuzu's emotions, returning her to her cheerful, energetic self. Though their situation is dire, she is happy to get a chance to talk to her best friend after thinking they may never meet again.

records.jp: 今もココロトープ内で眠り続ける夕月の妹。少女たちを外敵から守る雫世界を正確に維持・管理するため、すべての力を費やしている。想いが揺らいで雫世界の維持が不安定になると、それだけ来夢にも負担がかかってしまうが、物言わぬ彼女の状態は伺い知ることができない。
records.en_original: Yuzuki's younger sister, who still sleeps deep within the Heartscape. Lime uses all her power maintaining and overseeing the Oasis in order to protect the other girls. Fluctuating feelings can make the Oasis grow unstable, putting a tremendous strain on Lime, but she is unable to communicate this as she sleeps.
records.en: Yuzuki's younger sister, who still sleeps deep within the Heartscape. Lime uses all her power maintaining and overseeing the Oasis in order to protect the other girls. Fluctuating feelings can make the Oasis grow unstable, putting a tremendous strain on Lime, but she is unable to communicate this as she sleeps.

records.jp: ^00リフレクターを一か所に集めたことで、少女の数だけ存在し散らばっていた雫世界を管理する負担の軽減に成功。さらに、クマのぬいぐるみを通して日菜子たちと想いを共鳴させることで、ついに来夢は目を覚ました。どれだけの不安があろうとも、もう二度と会えないと思っていた大切な親友がこの世界にいる……それだけで来夢は未来に希望を見出すことができる。
records.en_original: ^00The girls successfully managed to reduce the burden of managing the Oasis by gathering all Reflectors in one place. By resonating with Lime's using a teddy bear, Hinako and the girls finally awaken the girl. Meeting a precious friend she though she may never meet again, Lime finds hope in this world.
records.en: ^00The girls successfully managed to reduce the burden of managing the Oasis by gathering all Reflectors in one place. By resonating with Lime's using a teddy bear, Hinako and the girls finally awaken the girl. Meeting a precious friend she though she may never meet again, Lime finds hope in this world.

records.jp: 愛央がこの世界に来る前に暮らしていた少女のうちの一人。この世界で目覚める前の記憶を失っているらしい。常に元気いっぱいで、考えるよりも先に行動を起こすタイプ。他の仲間たちと違い、自分だけリフレクターに変身できないことに不満を覚えている。
records.en_original: One of the girls who was already residing in this world before Ao arrived. She seems to be unable to recall anything prior to waking up here. Generally cheerful, she's the type that acts before thinking things through. Being the only one unable to transform into a Reflector bothers her.
records.en: One of the girls who was already residing in this world before Ao arrived. She seems to be unable to recall anything prior to waking up here. Generally cheerful, she's the type that acts before thinking things through. Being the only one unable to transform into a Reflector bothers her.

records.jp: ^00勇希は灰病により既に亡くなっていた。世界システムはその魂を利用し、勇希を復活させてスパイとして雫世界に送り込んだ。彼女に与えられた役目とは、発信機として雫世界内部にとどまり続け、消滅機構が攻撃する際の目印となること。罪悪感からわざと嫌われようとする勇希だが、愛央たちはそんな彼女を受け入れた。全員で助かる。それは、勇希も例外ではない。みんなの優しさに救われ、そして伶那と本心からぶつかり合うことができた勇希は、そのとき真の意味での仲間となった。
records.en_original: ^00Yuki died from Ash Syndrome before coming to Oasis. The World System took advantage of this, and revived Yuki in order to use her to spy on the other girls. Her duty was to function as a beacon that always transmitted their location to the System and its anti-virus. Wracked with guilt, Yuki attempts to get the girls to turn on her, but they forgive her instead, saying they won't leave anyone behind. Yuki comes back to her senses having felt the kindness of her friends, and shares her feelings with Rena.
records.en: ^00Yuki died from Ash Syndrome before coming to Oasis. The World System took advantage of this, and revived Yuki in order to use her to spy on the other girls. Her duty was to function as a beacon that always transmitted their location to the System and its anti-virus. Wracked with guilt, Yuki attempts to get the girls to turn on her, but they forgive her instead, saying they won't leave anyone behind. Yuki comes back to her senses having felt the kindness of her friends, and shares her feelings with Rena.

records.jp: ^00一度死んだ自分が、元の世界で再び生を受けることをどこかで諦めていた勇希だったが、ココロトープに刻まれた雫世界での新たな思い出が勇希の心を動かし、生への渇望を見出す。病気でできなかったいろんなことを、新しい世界ですべてやりつくすのだと。^00 ^00そうして勇希と愛央は、限りある命を全力で共に生きていく親友として特別な関係を築いた。
records.en_original: ^00Yuki had all but given up on the idea of returning to the real world, she was, after all, already dead. But the memories she recovered in the Heartscape awakened a powerful desire to live within her. There were so many things that she couldn't do due to her illness when she was still alive, and so many things she'd still like to do in this new world.^00 ^00And so, Ao and Yuki became close friends. Two girls who enjoyed life with everything they had.
records.en: ^00Yuki had all but given up on the idea of returning to the real world, she was, after all, already dead. But the memories she recovered in the Heartscape awakened a powerful desire to live within her. There were so many things that she couldn't do due to her illness when she was still alive, and so many things she'd still like to do in this new world.^00 ^00And so, Ao and Yuki became close friends. Two girls who enjoyed life with everything they had.

records.jp: 多くのリフレクターと浅からぬ因縁を持つ少女。痛みを感じる、与えることに生を実感する歪んだ性質を持っていた……はずなのだが、記憶喪失にともなってその歪みが消え、物腰柔らかな少女となっている。しかし、本質的には変わらず「駒川詩」であり、時折人とは違う一面を覗かせることも。
records.en_original: A girl with a connection to many Reflectors. She was once a cruel girl with a twisted view on life and pain, but few would be able to tell that with how she acts now. Her amnesia has turned Uta into a well-mannered and polite girl. Neither side more "Uta" than the other, they are two sides of the same coin.
records.en: A girl with a connection to many Reflectors. She was once a cruel girl with a twisted view on life and pain, but few would be able to tell that with how she acts now. Her amnesia has turned Uta into a well-mannered and polite girl. Neither side more "Uta" than the other, they are two sides of the same coin.

records.jp: ^00ココロトープの探索中“かつての詩”と“雫世界での詩”の人格が衝突。精神の均衡を失って大規模クラックを引き起こす事態となってしまった。雫世界で少女たちの優しい想いに触れた彼女は、かつての自分へと戻ってしまうことを恐れ過去と向き合うことを避けている。
records.en_original: ^00Uta's former and current personalities collided while exploring her Heartscape, causing her mental state to crack under the pressure, and along with it, causing a very large Crack to form. She fears returning to the person she once was, and wasting the kindness shown to her by the girls.
records.en: ^00Uta's former and current personalities collided while exploring her Heartscape, causing her mental state to crack under the pressure, and along with it, causing a very large Crack to form. She fears returning to the person she once was, and wasting the kindness shown to her by the girls.

records.jp: ^00自分の過去と向き合うことを決めた詩は、二度目の探索で記憶を取り戻すことに成功する。かつて彼女は神の力を用いて世界を自分が望む形に作り変えようとしていた。その時の計画が、少女たちに希望をもたらす。記憶を取り戻したことで、過去の自分との衝突が発生したが、その結果今の詩が打ち勝ったのか、それとも過去の詩に飲まれてしまったのか、両者が融合してしまったのかはわからない。一つ言えることは、今ここにいる詩は少女たちに協力し、人々の想いを繋ごうとする優しい少女であるということだ。
records.en_original: ^00Determined to finally face her past, Uta manages to regain her memories on a second expedition to her Heartscape. She recalls once attempting to use the power of a god to change the world to her liking. Having heard this plan, the girls find the hope they were looking for. Having regained her memories, Uta's personality begins to waver between her new and old selves, and it is unclear whether one wins, or the two merge together. Regardless, the Uta here is a kind girl who is keen on trying to understand the feelings of others.
records.en: ^00Determined to finally face her past, Uta manages to regain her memories on a second expedition to her Heartscape. She recalls once attempting to use the power of a god to change the world to her liking. Having heard this plan, the girls find the hope they were looking for. Having regained her memories, Uta's personality begins to waver between her new and old selves, and it is unclear whether one wins, or the two merge together. Regardless, the Uta here is a kind girl who is keen on trying to understand the feelings of others.

records.jp: ^00詩の心に刻まれていたひまわり畑の記憶。その記憶に対し抱く感情と、愛央と手をつないだ時に抱く感情がどこか似ていることに詩は気付く。その想いの正体を察し、詩は微笑んだ。^00 ^00そうして詩と愛央は、言葉を交わさずとも想い信じあえる友達として特別な関係を築いた。
records.en_original: ^00The memory of that sunflower field was forever engraved in Uta's heart. Uta realizes that the emotion she feels when thinking of those flowers and when holding Ao's hand are very similar. Uta smiles, having finally understand just how much those feelings mean to her.^00 ^00Uta and Ao became very special friends, able to trust each other without needing to say a single word.
records.en: ^00The memory of that sunflower field was forever engraved in Uta's heart. Uta realizes that the emotion she feels when thinking of those flowers and when holding Ao's hand are very similar. Uta smiles, having finally understand just how much those feelings mean to her.^00 ^00Uta and Ao became very special friends, able to trust each other without needing to say a single word.

records.jp: おしとやかで思慮深く、儚げな雰囲気をまとった少女。妹の陽桜莉とともにこの世界にやってきた。何かに取り組むときは頭の中でしっかりシミュレートするタイプだが、それゆえに一人で色々と抱え込んでしまう節がある。
records.en_original: A girl with a calm and graceful atmosphere. Mio and her sister, Hiori, came to this world together. Mio is the type of person that thoroughly evaluates and considers a situation from every possible angle before acting. Because of this, however, she has a bad habit of keeping her worries to herself.
records.en: A girl with a calm and graceful atmosphere. Mio and her sister, Hiori, came to this world together. Mio is the type of person that thoroughly evaluates and considers a situation from every possible angle before acting. Because of this, however, she has a bad habit of keeping her worries to herself.

records.jp: ^00母が行方不明になり、姉妹は二人で暮らすこととなった。陽桜莉を守れるのは自分しかいない。姉として大切な妹を守るべく、美弦は強くならなければいけなかった。時に衝突することもあったが、様々なことを経験した今の姉妹には固い絆が結ばれている。陽桜莉とは少々異なる経緯でリフレクターとなった美弦は、雫世界では戦うことができないようだ。代わりに美弦は、その明晰な頭脳と家事の腕を用い影から陽桜莉たちの生活を支える。
records.en_original: ^00After the disappearance of their mother, the siblings were left to fend for themselves. Believing that she was the only one who could protect her sister, Mio was determined to become strong. Though the girls' relationship wasn't without its ups and downs, but the sisters managed to overcome their hardships and formed an unbreakable bond. Becoming Reflectors at different times and for different reasons, only Mio is unable to fight inside of Oasis. Mio decided instead to support the others from the sidelines by using her strategic mind and aptitude for housekeeping.
records.en: ^00After the disappearance of their mother, the siblings were left to fend for themselves. Believing that she was the only one who could protect her sister, Mio was determined to become strong. Though the girls' relationship wasn't without its ups and downs, but the sisters managed to overcome their hardships and formed an unbreakable bond. Becoming Reflectors at different times and for different reasons, only Mio is unable to fight inside of Oasis. Mio decided instead to support the others from the sidelines by using her strategic mind and aptitude for housekeeping.

records.jp: ^00過去の失敗から新たな一歩を踏み出すことを恐れていた美弦だったが、陽桜莉の協力のもと、抱えていた罪悪感を乗り越えることに成功する。世界が素敵なものであふれていることを思い出した美弦は、また少しずつ前向きに生きていけるだろう。^00 ^00そうして美弦と愛央は、共に素敵なものを見つけていく友達として特別な関係を築いた。
records.en_original: ^00Having become unable to move forward due to mistakes made in the past, Mio was able to overcome her guilt with the help of Hiori. Reminded of all the beautiful things in the world, Mio recovered her positive attitude.^00 ^00Mio and Ao became very close, enjoying all the wonderful things the world has to offer.
records.en: ^00Having become unable to move forward due to mistakes made in the past, Mio was able to overcome her guilt with the help of Hiori. Reminded of all the beautiful things in the world, Mio recovered her positive attitude.^00 ^00Mio and Ao became very close, enjoying all the wonderful things the world has to offer.

records.jp: どこか浮世離れした、つかみどころのない少女。常識知らずな一面があり、彼女独自の世界観を構築している。かつては「神の声が聞こえる」という特殊な力を持っていたが、この世界では聞こえないらしい。詩帆と同じチームで戦っていた過去を持つ。
records.en_original: A strange girl who seems to live in her own world. Often lost in this world, she can be lacking in common sense. She used to be able to hear the voice of a god known as the Divine, but it seems she stopped hearing it after coming to this world. She and Shiho fought on the same team in the past.
records.en: A strange girl who seems to live in her own world. Often lost in this world, she can be lacking in common sense. She used to be able to hear the voice of a god known as the Divine, but it seems she stopped hearing it after coming to this world. She and Shiho fought on the same team in the past.

records.jp: ^00「神の声が聞こえる」という力から、幼かったきららは村総出で担ぎ上げられ、権力を求めた親にも利用されてしまう。ある日、きららは親の陰謀により、友達に悪事の濡れ衣を着せ陥れることに協力させられそうになる。しかし彼女はそれを拒否し、これまで積み上げてきた地位や名誉と引き換えにたった一人の友人を守った。本当に大切にしなければいけないものは何なのか。神の声も教えてくれなかったことを、彼女は知っている。
records.en_original: ^00As a child, Kirara was both revered by her village, and exploited by her parents for her ability to hear the voice of the Divine. One day, after her parents asked her to falsely accuse her friend of something she hadn't done, she refused her parents and protected her only friend. In exchange however, she was forced throw away her status in the village, and the reverence people once had for her. It can be hard to decide what is truly important to you. Not even the Divine can tell you.
records.en: ^00As a child, Kirara was both revered by her village, and exploited by her parents for her ability to hear the voice of the Divine. One day, after her parents asked her to falsely accuse her friend of something she hadn't done, she refused her parents and protected her only friend. In exchange however, she was forced throw away her status in the village, and the reverence people once had for her. It can be hard to decide what is truly important to you. Not even the Divine can tell you.

records.jp: ^00神の声が聞こえることが当たり前だったきららは、声が聞こえなくなったことで人との接し方にも不安を感じていた。また、神の声が聞こえない自分には価値がないのではないかとも思い詰めていた。しかし、ユカと友達になった時の記憶、そして今のきららを必要としてくれた愛央の想いが彼女の自信を取り戻させた。きららは、神の声が聞こえなくてもきららとして生きていくことを受け入れる。^00 ^00そうしてきららと愛央は、特別なものなどなくても共にいられる友達として特別な関係を築いた。
records.en_original: ^00To Kirara, hearing the voice of the Divine was an everyday occurrence, which made it all the harder when she could no longer hear it. How was she supposed to connect with others now? What was she without the Divine? Thanks to her memories of her childhood friend Yuka, and talking with Ao about their feelings, Kirara learned to make peace with the idea of a life without the Divine.^00 ^00So Ao and Kirara learned that they didn't need something special that set them apart, as long as they had each other.
records.en: ^00To Kirara, hearing the voice of the Divine was an everyday occurrence, which made it all the harder when she could no longer hear it. How was she supposed to connect with others now? What was she without the Divine? Thanks to her memories of her childhood friend Yuka, and talking with Ao about their feelings, Kirara learned to make peace with the idea of a life without the Divine.^00 ^00So Ao and Kirara learned that they didn't need something special that set them apart, as long as they had each other.
